pages.title: Poop Tree
pages.text: The mature form of a poop sapling, made of poop logs, poop wood, and poop leaves.
Use a stonecutter to turn poop logs into poop empty logs.$(br2)Empty logs accelerate POP later in the second category, Filth Gives Life.

pages.title: Carbonizing
pages.text: When poop wood is enclosed on all six sides by opaque solid blocks, it slowly turns into a coal block.$(br2)Leaves cannot seal it, so keep every side filled while you wait.

pages.title: Harvest
pages.text: Without Silk Touch, breaking poop logs or poop wood drops 4 to 5 spall.$(br2)Leaves drop poop and may also drop roundworms.
